meta.name: add-signal
meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

copy.tagline: 接入 Signal 消息渠道，实现原生收发。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里直接收发 Signal 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Signal channel for native messaging.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send and receive Signal messages in your app.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会以你现有 Signal 号码的“辅助设备”身份收发消息:别人给该号码发私信、把该号码拉进群,或你通过 Note to Self 发消息,它都会收到并回复;无需新号码或 Bot API。
howto.when: 完成安装、重启并接线后,当有人向已关联的 Signal 号码私信,或在该号码所在的群组里发消息时触发;新 Signal 用户未被授权前会先被丢弃。

say.text: 请用加粗和斜体回复:收到。
say.note: 用于验证 Signal 里的 Markdown 格式转换。

say.text: 这是一条 Note to Self 测试,收到请回复。
say.note: 机主同号收发;回复会进同一对话。

say.text: 这是另一个 Signal 账号发来的私聊,请回复。
say.note: 消息会以 signal:{UUID} 标识该用户。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude joins your existing Signal number as a secondary device via signal-cli — no new number or bot API. It can then receive and reply to Signal DMs, group messages, and Note to Self messages sent to that number.
howto.when_en: After setup, restart, and channel wiring, it triggers on incoming DMs to the linked Signal number or messages in a group that includes that number. New Signal users are dropped until granted access.

say_en.text: Reply with bold and italic: Received.
This is a Note to Self test. Please reply.
say_en.note: Verifies owner-account routing via your own number.

say_en.text: This is a DM from another Signal account. Please reply.
say_en.note: The sender is identified as signal:{UUID}.
